import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(33.0, 33.0, 83.0)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .center(1.5, 1.5)
    .pushPoints([(-12.0, -15.0), (0.0, -15.0), (12.0, -15.0)])
    .hole(2.0)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .pushPoints([(-15.0, -12.0), (-15.0, 0.0), (-15.0, 12.0)])
    .hole(2.0)
)
show_object(result)
